milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-B current-truth sync after the dependency-aware gate
milestoneContract.objective: Bring the canonical current-truth documents and the pinned doc-truth validator constants in line with the reviewed dependency-aware state, persist the independent review records, and record open findings, using only Founder-authorized protected changes.
requirements: [V6-PKG-B-CURRENT-TRUTH-SYNC-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.rule] (a) CANONICAL-STATUS.md is updated to the new truth: lock present, canonical 34/34, independent review CLEAN. (b) The pinned scope/status expectations in validate-paste4c-doc-truth.mjs move to the new state; all overclaim checks (SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE=false, seal, Phase0, ZIP) stay unchanged. (c) In validate-paste4d-release-truth.mjs only the two pinned constants move to the new truth (dependency-aware PASS and the open-finding record); all overclaim checks (source closure false, seal, SHA256SUMS, release authenticity, ZIP, Phase0) stay unchanged. Non-protected state files and the review records belong to the same package.

[V6-PKG-B-CURRENT-TRUTH-SYNC-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.constraint] Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

The current-truth documents state only facts supported by the committed checkpoints and review records, keep SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE=false, FINAL_TRUST_ROOT_SEAL=STALE_PENDING_FINAL_RESEAL, FINAL_SHA256SUMS=NOT_DONE, FINAL_RELEASE_AUTHENTICITY=NOT_DONE, FINAL_ZIP=NOT_DONE and TARGET_MACHINE_PHASE0=PENDING, and report open findings instead of a zero-blocker claim.
In validate-paste4c-doc-truth.mjs and validate-paste4d-release-truth.mjs only pinned scope/status constants change (plus one added requirement), and every overclaim check stays unchanged.

Every audit/reviews record is internally consistent: reviewResultText hashes to reviewResultSha256, frozenBundle hashes with stableStringify to bundleDigest, and the recorded result matches the reviewer output or environment-block record.
Only the Founder-authorized protected files change, and no existing test assertion, validator or policy is weakened beyond the authorized rule.
mandatoryFailureCases: overclaimed closure or seal in any current-truth document
zero-blocker claim while a P1 is open
review record whose text or bundle hash does not match
validator overclaim check removed or weakened
